how_made.instruct: A British woman in her thirties with a gentle Yorkshire accent from the north of England. Warm, friendly, calm and cosy, soft Northern vowels, relaxed and unhurried. British English female narrator reading a picture book aloud to a small child. She reads slowly, at a relaxed bedtime-story pace, letting each phrase breathe with soft pauses at the commas. Gentle and calm throughout, never shouty, never dramatic, no sudden changes in volume or pitch.
